tools.name: search_payor_policies
tools.description: Search payor prior authorization policy documents using semantic search. Finds relevant coverage criteria, medical necessity requirements, and documentation requirements from uploaded payor policy documents.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g., 'MRI lumbar spine prior auth requirements for UnitedHealthcare')

payor_name.description: Optional: Filter by payor name (e.g., 'UnitedHealthcare', 'Aetna', 'Blue Cross Blue Shield')

procedure_code.description: Optional: CPT or HCPCS procedure code to search for

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: upload_policy_document
tools.description: Upload a payor policy document to the knowledge base for indexing. Supports prior auth policies, coverage criteria, medical necessity guidelines, and formularies. Documents are stored in S3 and automatically indexed for semantic search.

document_type.description: Type of document: prior_auth_policy, coverage_criteria, medical_necessity, formulary, general

filename.description: Optional filename. Auto-generated if not provided.

tools.name: list_policy_documents
tools.description: List uploaded payor policy documents. Optionally filter by payor name.

tools.name: lookup_prior_auth_requirements
tools.description: Look up prior authorization requirements for a specific CPT/HCPCS procedure code. Combines knowledge base search with structured reference data to determine if prior auth is required and what documentation is needed.

procedure_code.description: CPT or HCPCS procedure code (e.g., '72148' for MRI Lumbar Spine)

payor_name.description: Optional: Payor name for payor-specific rules

description.description: Optional: medication or procedure name/display (e.g., 'adalimumab 40 MG/0.8 ML [Humira]'). Used to flag specialty/biologic drugs when the code is a product-level RxNorm code not in the reference table.
